meta.name: brainstorming
meta.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.

copy.tagline: 在开发前梳理需求与设计思路
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在开始编码前需要系统性地探索用户意图和功能需求。
copy.tagline_en: Clarify requirements and design before implementation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically explore user intent and functional requirements before coding.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会在开始任何创造性工作前，先通过对话理解你的意图、需求和设计，提出2-3种方案并推荐，然后呈现设计并获得批准，之后才进入实施。
howto.when: 当你提出任何与添加功能、修改行为等创意相关的工作时触发。注意：即使项目看起来很简单，也会触发此流程。

say.text: 我想给这个应用增加一个搜索功能。
say.note: Claude会开始探索需求和设计。

say.text: 我们来讨论一下新模块的设计方案。

howto.what_en: After installation, before any creative work (adding features, modifying behavior, etc.), Claude will first understand your intent, requirements, and design through dialogue, propose 2-3 approaches with recommendations, present the design for approval, then proceed to implementation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you make any request related to creative work such as adding features or modifying behavior. This applies even for projects that seem simple.

say_en.text: I want to add a search feature to this app.
say_en.note: Claude will start exploring requirements and design.

say_en.text: Let's discuss the design of a new module.
say_en.note: Claude will propose 2-3 approaches and recommend one.
